observations: body L1-L4: the end of the sentence begun on p. 311: in a direction the star's latitude is taken into account by using, instead of its degree of longitude, the degree of the ecliptic that culminates with it (for right ascensions) or rises with it (for oblique ascensions).
body L5-L8: «al–Qummī», «al–Bīrūnī» and «Oloug Beg» are letter-spaced; «Abū Naṣr» is not. «al–Qummī», «al–Bīrūnī», «157–58» and «209–210» have long dashes (5.3, 5.3, 5.5 and 5.5 pt).

body L9-L16: the sign of equality (L10) measures 9.6 pt. «Bouché–Leclercq» is letter-spaced, with a long dash (5.2 pt). The d of «videlicet» (L12) prints broken. The Greek ἀκτινοβολία (L12, L15) is set as printed; its kappa is printed in the curly form (ϰ).

body L17-L27: «Az–Zarqālī», «Persae», «Regiomontanus», «Ibn Hibintà», divided between L24 and L25, «Muḥammad ibn Mūsà al–Khuwārizmī», divided between L25 and L26, are letter-spaced; «Ioannes a Monteregio», «Ibn Hibintà» (L26) and «al–Khuwārizmī» (L27) are not. «Az–Zarqālī», «r.–v.», «al–Khuwā-», «35,r.–37,v.» and «al–Khuwārizmī» have long dashes (5.3 to 5.5 pt). «in eclipticae» (L22) is printed so.
body L28-L30: «Albatenianis» is letter-spaced; the e of «hae» (L28) prints broken.

notes_left L1-L6: «Ahlwardt» (L1-L2, L6) and «Suter» are letter-spaced. The i of «capitum» prints broken; «nr 5661» (L4) is printed without a full stop. The dash before «Al-Qummī» measures 7.6 pt; «1887-99» and «74-75» have hyphens (2.6 pt each).

notes_left L7-L18: «Iohannes de Saxonia» and «Pseudo-Ptolemaei» are letter-spaced; the closing parenthesis of «(3)» prints broken, like a comma. «creticorum» (L11) is printed so. The Greek ἐποχήν (L14) is set as printed: the lower right stroke of the χ prints apart, like a dot below the line, and the acute over the η prints as a point. The e of «peragrationem» (L14) prints broken, like a c. The hyphens of «late-» and «invene-» (L14, L15) print as points.

notes_right L1-L13: «Nöldeke» and «aṭ-Ṭabarī», divided between L9 and L10, are letter-spaced. The dash before «False» (L5) measures 8.4 pt; «1894-95» and «aṭ-Ṭa-» have hyphens (3.4 and 2.4 pt), «al–Khuwārizmī» and «al–munaǵǵim» long dashes (4.2 and 4.6 pt); the hyphen of «Ge-» (L6) prints as a point. «Al-Ḫuwârizmî» is set as printed, with ḫ, â and î. By the tabular calendar counted from 15 July 622, the year 232 of the Hiǵrah began on 27 August 846, as printed (28 August from 16 July 622).
notes_right L14-L17: the o of «proiectiones» (L15) prints broken. Note 5 goes on on p. 313. The formula cos x = cos 60° : cos β is the rule of p. 308 with the radius 1.
